description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierAndroid class, which observes and forwards Android network change events to observers, including related classes and methods.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierAndroid
classes.description: Class that observes Android network events and forwards them to the NetworkChangeNotifier system, managing network state and observer notifications.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the current network connection cost.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: AreNetworkHandlesCurrentlySupported
methods.description: Checks if network handles are supported.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Gets a list of currently connected networks.

methods.name: GetCurrentNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the connection type for a specific network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns the current network connection subtype.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActiveInternal
methods.description: Checks if the default network is active.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Callback for when the connection type changes.

methods.name: OnConnectionCostChanged
methods.description: Callback for when the connection cost changes.

methods.name: OnMaxBandwidthChanged
methods.description: Callback for when maximum bandwidth changes.

methods.name: OnNetworkConnected
methods.description: Callback for when a network connects.

methods.name: OnNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Callback for when a network is about to disconnect.

methods.name: OnNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Callback for when a network disconnects.

methods.name: OnNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Callback for when a network becomes default.

methods.name: OnDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Callback for when the default network becomes active.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverAdded
methods.description: Registers observer for default network active events.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverRemoved
methods.description: Unregisters observer for default network active events.
